title: Add length limits and filling tips to multi-line descriptions
goal: uses a textarea to receive multiple lines of text and associate accessible auxiliary instructions.
summary: The borrowing purpose may be divided into several lines. The tag is responsible for naming, and the description paragraph is responsible for reminding the length requirements.
tasks: Change #reason to textarea, keep label and name, set 4 lines, up to 120 characters, required.
Use aria-describedby to associate an existing #reason-guide.

example.code: can supplement the collection time.
example.note: textarea requires closing tag. The value of aria-describedby is the ID of the description element, without #.

hint: length limit corresponds to maxlength, and the number of rows is written in rows.
